title: Firm that lets you rent out your idle Mac for AI inference workloads warns of plummeting token costs
content: Mac users sharing their compute for AI inference are seeing declining revenues as token prices continue to drop, with Anthropic token falling 77% in under five months.

title: Intel shifts production capacity from consumer to server CPUs in face of 'unprecedented' AI demand
content: Intel is expanding chipmaking and advanced packaging capacity across the U.S., Ireland, and Malaysia to meet surging AI-driven demand for data center CPUs amid shrinking PC market and persistent supply constraints.

content: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman believes that having large amounts of RAM installed in personal computers is an inefficient use of the world's increasingly limited DRAM supply, arguing that cloud data centers can make better use of these resources. His comments come at a particularly controversial time, as the AI industry's enormous demand for memory continues to drive consumer hardware prices through the roof.
